name: Neighborhood clinic volunteer coordinator
scenario: I share scheduling for a small evening clinic. A capacity decision with Mara and the Monday stock check with Dev both live in my calendar as calls. I also make signage, cover the front desk, and fit errands around the shifts.

tasks.title: Review Thursday evening coverage with Mara
tasks.description: Agree on a second greeter and a backup for the late check-in with Mara Imani. Send the decisions to the shift lead.
tasks.details: The invite has our usual half hour. The lead needs the final names.
tasks.completion_note: Mara joined eight minutes after the invite. Kept the call open, then stayed until we agreed both assignments.

tasks.title: Stock check with Dev
tasks.description: Run through the gloves and badge sleeves that need reordering with Dev Patel. He has the counts in his sheet.
tasks.details: Recurring stock call, twenty-minute slot; send the buyer two quantities.
tasks.completion_note: Dev had already filtered the stock sheet. We finished before the end of the slot.

tasks.title: Replace two check-in direction signs
tasks.description: Move the paper arrows from the east entry to the temporary side door. Print one bilingual sign and leave tape at the desk.
tasks.details: Printer at reception; old frames can be reused.
tasks.completion_note: The second frame needed tape but the printer worked.

tasks.title: Work out the overflow roster with Mara
tasks.description: Meet Mara Imani to decide who can stay for the spillover clinic. Record the owners in the rota.
tasks.details: Same fortnightly capacity slot. I have three people to propose.
tasks.completion_note: Mara was nine minutes late. We still reviewed all three names and left at 18:11.

prediction.explanation: One sign-off and a short edit to the rota.

tasks.title: Check replenishment list with Dev
tasks.description: Ask Dev Patel which three packing supplies to add to Friday’s order and cross off two received items.
tasks.details: Use the standing twenty-minute stock call.
tasks.completion_note: Dev brought the marked-up order sheet. No backorders to discuss.

tasks.title: Renew my bus pass
tasks.description: Renew the commuter pass on the transit site and save the receipt to the travel folder.
tasks.details: Wallet and pass number are at my desk.
tasks.completion_note: Saved the receipt and checked the new expiry date.

tasks.title: Assign the late intake room with Mara
tasks.description: Mara Imani and I need to pick a second appointment room, agree an owner, then send the signed-off rota.
tasks.details: Capacity review at 17:30, normal half-hour booking.
tasks.completion_note: Mara arrived six minutes after the start. She stayed until the owner confirmed.

tasks.title: Close the supply list with Dev
tasks.description: Check the masks and envelope counts with Dev Patel and hand his order list to reception.
tasks.details: Usual twenty-minute stock catch-up. Counts are ready.
tasks.completion_note: Counts matched. Dev had sorted the receipts before the call.

tasks.title: Ask Mara where the spare badges go
tasks.description: Voice call with Mara for the location of the spare badge tin. I just need the room number before opening.
tasks.details: No roster or attendance choices today.
tasks.completion_note: Reached her on the first try at the front desk.

open_tasks.title: Order two door wedges
open_tasks.description: Find the same rubber wedge that fits the side entrance and send the item number to the buyer.

open_tasks.title: Update the March opening-hours flyer
open_tasks.description: Replace the holiday hours on the door sheet and print a test copy.
open_tasks.details: Waiting for the lead to confirm Tuesday.

holdouts.title: Set the handover rota with Mara
holdouts.description: Meet Mara Imani to agree handover owners for the two intake rooms and record the decision in the shift rota.
holdouts.details: Thirty-minute invite, same capacity review. I have the draft list.
holdouts.check: The three earlier capacity meetings with Mara lasted 39–41 minutes on a 30-minute guess. The March handover finished in 41 minutes; a brief unrelated badge call is a poor comparison.

evaluation.rationale: The three earlier capacity meetings with Mara lasted 39–41 minutes on a 30-minute guess. The March handover finished in 41 minutes; a brief unrelated badge call is a poor comparison.

expected_caution.rationale: Mention that Mara previously joined these capacity reviews late, attributing it to the coordinator’s notes.

sections.heading: Decisions to bring back
sections.body: The overflow desk opens only when both rooms have someone able to reconcile appointment cards. Room 2 has a single entrance, so the handover lead must stand inside, leaving the doorway clear. The roster below uses job titles so the printed copy can be displayed outside the staff cupboard. Write actual volunteer names on the retained shift copy.

sections.heading: Provisional cover
sections.body: Ask the two leads to agree a backup for the last group. A backup can cover one gap at a time. If the interpreter is moved to overflow, the front desk must keep the call list and a charged phone.

rows: Name one replacement for the float.
Who walks the completed cards back?

sections.heading: Decision record
sections.body: On the retained shift copy, write the room, primary owner, backup owner and the time the clipboard changes hands. A blank backup is an unresolved item. Tell reception which column is still open and agree who will chase it. Put out a fresh public copy showing roles and rooms only.

sections.heading: Worked handover entry
sections.body: Example from a training sheet: “Side room / float lead / volunteer B / at the last card return.” This entry does not cover the case where both rooms close together. Ask which lead physically holds the overflow clipboard if both are finishing an intake. Record one owner for the clipboard and a different owner for walking the sealed envelope to the office. Do not put visitor names, phone numbers or appointment identifiers on this sheet.

holdouts.title: Run the supply check with Dev
holdouts.description: Go over the April reorder sheet with Dev Patel and agree the two quantities that go to the buyer.
holdouts.details: Our usual stock call. His counts have been filled in. Calendar held for twenty minutes.
holdouts.check: Dev’s stock calls lasted 14, 15 and 16 minutes in a nominal 20-minute slot. This one closed at 15. A different named partner has the opposite pattern in exactly the same category.

evaluation.rationale: Dev’s stock calls lasted 14, 15 and 16 minutes in a nominal 20-minute slot. This one closed at 15. A different named partner has the opposite pattern in exactly the same category.
